# Trivy IaC exemptions for the shared security workflow (security / iac).
# id | path | expires (YYYY-MM-DD) | issue | reason
#
# Each row is either kept on purpose (the reason says why the finding is
# true by design; issue #317) or deferred (the fix is larger than a config
# change; issue #322, short expiry so the gate asks again). Fix a deferred
# finding and delete its row. A new row needs a real reason, not the Trivy
# title.
